name: swiftui-liquid-glass
tagline_zh: 写代码的顺手工具：swiftui-liquid-glass。英文简介见下。
desc_en: Implement, review, or improve SwiftUI features using the iOS 26+ Liquid Glass API. Use when asked to adopt Liquid Glass in new SwiftUI UI, refactor an existing feature to Liquid Glass, or review Liquid Glass usage for correctness, performance, and design alignment.
